canonical_example.text: Hablo bien español, pero a veces no agarro los chistes que cuenta la gente.
canonical_example.translation: I speak Spanish well, but sometimes I don't get the jokes that people tell.

canonical_example.text: He agarrado un resfriado muy malo.
canonical_example.translation: I've caught a really bad cold.

canonical_example.text: El profesor le agarró con una chuleta en la manga.
canonical_example.translation: The teacher caught him with a cheat-sheet in his sleeve.

canonical_example.text: Agarra bien para que no se caiga.
canonical_example.translation: Hold on tightly so that it doesn't fall.

canonical_example.text: La familia agarró para el campo para pasar un día tranquilo allí.
canonical_example.translation: The family headed for the country to spend a relaxing day there.

canonical_example.text: Si no tratas un poco mejor a tu novia, va a agarrar e irse.
canonical_example.translation: If you don't treat your girlfriend better, she's going to up and leave.

canonical_example.text: La planta no agarra si la tierra está demasiado suelta.
canonical_example.translation: The plant won't take root if the earth is too loose.

canonical_example.text: No me gustan tanto esas llantas porque no agarran en las curvas.
canonical_example.translation: I don't like these tires as much because they don't grip on the curves.

canonical_example.text: No sé qué pasa. El tinte no agarra.
canonical_example.translation: I don't know what's wrong. The dye isn't taking.

canonical_example.text: Agarró y se fue sin decir nada.
canonical_example.translation: He upped and left without saying anything.

canonical_example.text: El gato se cayó después de agarrar la rama que se rompió.
canonical_example.translation: The cat fell after it gripped the broken branch.

canonical_example.text: Los huevos se agarraron a la sartén porque no le pusiste aceite.
canonical_example.translation: The eggs stuck to the pan because you didn't use oil.

canonical_example.text: Esos dos muchachos van a agarrarse si alguien no los separa.
canonical_example.translation: Those two guys are going to have a fight if someone doesn't separate them.

canonical_example.text: Anoche salimos a la disco y nos agarramos una borrachera.
canonical_example.translation: Last night we went out to a club and got good and drunk.

canonical_example.text: Tu madre se agarrará un cabreo cuando se entere de esto.
canonical_example.translation: Your mother is going to be pissed when she finds out about this.

canonical_example.text: Te agarras a tu herida para evitar las tareas en casa.
canonical_example.translation: You use your injury to get out of chores around the house.

canonical_example.text: Esa pálida criatura de largos colmillos debe de ser un vampiro porque no se ve su imagen en el espejo.
canonical_example.translation: That pale creature with the long fangs must be a vampire because you can't see its reflection in the mirror.

canonical_example.text: Esa vampira le quitó hasta el último peso a su marido.
canonical_example.translation: That vampire took every last cent of her husband's money.

canonical_example.text: Al dueño de la fábrica no le importa explotar a la gente, porque es un vampiro.
canonical_example.translation: The owner of the factory doesn't mind exploiting people because he's a bloodsucker.

canonical_example.text: Estos vampiros se alimentan únicamente de sangre.
canonical_example.translation: These vampire bats feed only on blood.

canonical_example.text: Le mandaron que no se moviera ni hiciera nada.
canonical_example.translation: He was ordered to stay still and do nothing.

canonical_example.text: El policía le mandó que se detuviera.
canonical_example.translation: The policeman commanded him to stop.

canonical_example.text: ¿Debería mandarle flores para su cumpleaños?
canonical_example.translation: Should I send her flowers for her birthday?

canonical_example.text: Mi mamá me mandó a la panadería a comprar una barra de pan.
canonical_example.translation: My mom sent me to the bakery to buy a loaf of bread.

canonical_example.text: El médico le mandó una pastilla para su dolor de cabeza.
canonical_example.translation: The doctor prescribed a pill for his headache.

canonical_example.text: El profesor mandó a los alumnos estar callados mientras hacían el examen.
canonical_example.translation: The teacher told the students to be quiet during the exam.

canonical_example.text: Durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial, mi abuelo mandaba el cuerpo de paracaidistas.
canonical_example.translation: During World War II, my grandfather was in command of the parachute corps.

canonical_example.text: ¿Quién manda el coro de niños que cantó en el festival?
canonical_example.translation: Who is in charge of the children's choir that sang at the festival?

canonical_example.text: La abuela me mandó a venir a pasar la tarde con ella.
canonical_example.translation: Grandma sent for me to come and spend the afternoon with her.

canonical_example.text: El portero mandó el balón al delantero de su equipo.
canonical_example.translation: The goalkeeper sent the ball to his team's center-forward.

canonical_example.text: El jugador de tenis mandó la pelota directamente al cuerpo de su adversario.
canonical_example.translation: The tennis player hit the ball right to his opponent.

canonical_example.text: Mandó su anillo de bodas al mar después de divorciarse.
canonical_example.translation: She threw her wedding ring into the sea after getting divorced.

canonical_example.text: Él manda hasta que el capitán lo releve.
canonical_example.translation: He is in command until he is relieved by the Captain.

canonical_example.text: El gerente manda en el departamento de ventas de la compañía.
canonical_example.translation: The manager is in charge of the sales department of the company.

canonical_example.text: Mi hermano siempre se manda cada excusa para no hacer los deberes.
canonical_example.translation: My brother always comes out with great excuses to not do his homework.

canonical_example.text: Se empachó después de haberse mandado toda la torta.
canonical_example.translation: He got an upset stomach after polishing off the whole cake.

canonical_example.text: La salsa estaba tan picosa que se mandó toda la jarra de cerveza.
canonical_example.translation: The salsa was so hot that he knocked back the whole pitcher of beer.

canonical_example.text: Sergio estaba tan nervioso antes de la cita que se mandó un whisky.
canonical_example.translation: Sergio was so nervous before the meeting that he downed a whiskey.

canonical_example.text: Ese primo tuyo se manda con nosotros.
canonical_example.translation: That cousin of yours takes advantage of us.

canonical_example.text: Dile que se mande cambiar.
canonical_example.translation: Tell him to clear off.

canonical_example.text: No se manda desde que se rompió la pierna.
canonical_example.translation: He can't get around by himself since he broke his leg.

canonical_example.text: La gente usaba máscaras coloridas en la fiesta de disfraces.
canonical_example.translation: People wore colorful masks at the costume party.

canonical_example.text: Bajo su máscara de alegría se esconde una persona muy triste.
canonical_example.translation: Under her mask of happiness, there's a very sad person.

canonical_example.text: Los bomberos traían máscaras para no inhalar el humo.
canonical_example.translation: The firefighters had masks so that they wouldn't breathe in the smoke.

canonical_example.text: Voy a comprar la máscara que alarga las pestañas.
canonical_example.translation: I'll buy the mascara that makes eyelashes look longer.

canonical_example.text: La máscara del auto estaba muy caliente.
canonical_example.translation: The car's grill was very hot.

canonical_example.text: Los manifestantes iniciaron acciones de desobediencia civil para no caer en la violencia.
canonical_example.translation: The protesters engaged in civil disobedience so as to remain nonviolent.

canonical_example.text: El número de civiles desarmados muertos a manos de la policía se ha convertido en un gran problema en los últimos años.
canonical_example.translation: The number of unarmed civilians killed by police officers has become a huge problem in recent years.

canonical_example.text: Como no quisieron casarse en una iglesia, la pareja celebró una boda civil.
canonical_example.translation: Because they did not want to get married in a church, the couple had a civil wedding.

canonical_example.text: La semana pasada fui al juzgado para dar testimonio en un caso civil.
canonical_example.translation: Last week I went to the courthouse to provide testimony in a civil case.

canonical_example.text: El racismo y las diferencias culturales provocaron la última guerra civil en la región.
canonical_example.translation: Racism and cultural differences provoked the most recent civil war in the region.

canonical_example.text: Cuando no estés en la base militar, debes llevar ropa civil.
canonical_example.translation: When you are not on the military base, you must wear civilian clothes.

canonical_example.text: Lo siento, señora, pero solo pueden pasar los civiles más allá de este punto.
canonical_example.translation: I am sorry, ma'am, but only the civil guards may go beyond this point.

canonical_example.text: Levanta la mano si quieres ir al parque.
canonical_example.translation: Raise your hand if you want to go to the park.

canonical_example.text: No es capaz de levantar la maleta.
canonical_example.translation: He is unable to lift the suitcase.

canonical_example.text: Se inclinó para levantar la silla del suelo.
canonical_example.translation: He bent over to pick up the chair off the floor.

canonical_example.text: La torre del reloj se levantó en 1836.
canonical_example.translation: The clock tower was built in 1836.

canonical_example.text: ¿Puedes ayudarme a levantar el sofá?
canonical_example.translation: Can you help me lift up the sofa?

canonical_example.text: El tribunal debe levantar la orden de detención.
canonical_example.translation: The court must lift the detention order.

canonical_example.text: Mi abuelo levantó su compañía en 1939.
canonical_example.translation: My grandfather founded his company in 1939.

canonical_example.text: Levantaron el laboratorio para dejar sitio a la nueva escuela.
canonical_example.translation: The laboratory was taken down to make room for the new school.

canonical_example.text: Levanta tus cosas de la mesa.
canonical_example.translation: Clear your things off the table.

canonical_example.text: ¿Qué se puede hacer para levantar una mancha de vino?
canonical_example.translation: What can you do to remove a wine stain?

canonical_example.text: ¿A qué hora te levantaste hoy?
canonical_example.translation: What time did you get up today?

canonical_example.text: Levántate que el suelo no está limpio.
canonical_example.translation: Get up, the floor is not clean.

canonical_example.text: Caín se levantó contra Abel y lo mató.
canonical_example.translation: Cain rose up against Abel and killed him.

canonical_example.text: Tenía el cuerpo quemado y se le levantaba la piel al tocarla.
canonical_example.translation: His body was burned and his skin came off when touched.

canonical_example.text: Cuando el miembro de la oposición acusó al ministro de malversación, se armó una polvareda.
canonical_example.translation: When the opposition member accused the minister of embezzlement, mayhem broke out.

canonical_example.text: Podíamos oír los leones rugir afuera de nuestra tienda de campaña en Sudáfrica.
canonical_example.translation: We could hear the lions roar outside our tent in South Africa.

canonical_example.text: Vieron un león en la jungla en El Salvador.
canonical_example.translation: They saw a puma in the jungle in El Salvador.

canonical_example.text: El baño principal de la nueva casa tiene una tina grande separada de la ducha.
canonical_example.translation: The master bath in the new house has a bathtub separate from the shower.

canonical_example.text: Voy a llenar la tina con agua caliente y tomar un baño de burbujas.
canonical_example.translation: I'm going to fill the tub with hot water and take a bubble bath.

canonical_example.text: Llenaron una tina grande con hielo para mantener las bebidas frías durante la fiesta.
canonical_example.translation: They filled a large tub with ice to keep the drinks cold during the party.

canonical_example.text: Las bodegas vinícolas fermentan el vino en tinas de madera y tanques de acero inoxidable.
canonical_example.translation: Wineries use wooden vats and stainless steel tanks to ferment wine.

canonical_example.text: Pon a remojar la ropa sucia en la tina con solo un poquito de jabón.
canonical_example.translation: Soak the dirty clothes in the washtub with just a bit of soap.
